discription: I create beautiful, responsive web applications using modern technologies. A multilingual creator passionate about communication, problem-solving, and meaningful experiences.
contactAlertMsg: Thank you for your message! I'll get back to you soon.

introduction.para2: I came to Japan in 2014 to study the Japanese language and later pursued an IT-focused degree in the Faculty of English Information Management. After graduating, I gained experience in hotel front-desk operations as well as translation and interpretation as a dispatch employee. I also hold a TOEIC score of 755.
introduction.para3: I am skilled in Java, React, JavaScript, HTML & CSS, Word,Excel, and PowerPoint, and I can communicate in four languages:Japanese, English, Nepali, and Hindi. Leveraging my multicultural background and strong communication skills, I thrive in diverse environments and aim to contribute value through both my technical abilities and adaptability.

educationDatas.description: I graduate my high school in Nepal with science stream and mathematics.I had also studied english,computer and social morality.
I studied Japanese language in kyushu international education institute which is located in Hakata city of Fukuoka prefecture.

After graduate from japanese language school, I got admission in shumei university of chiba prefecture. In university i join faculty of English and Information Management with IT career where i studied Programming languages,graphics and design,database,etc
I learnt and trained HTML,CSS and JAVASCRIPT in design school located in shibuya city with japanese teacher for 3 months (3hours per weeks)

workHistory.description: Responsible for a broad range of front desk operations, including check-in and check-out procedures, reservation management, telephone inquiries, and support for international guests. Demonstrated strong customer service skills with the ability to respond appropriately and professionally in various situations, including unforeseen challenges. Enhanced language proficiency—particularly in English—through frequent communication with overseas guests, while maintaining a high standard of service and hospitality.

I was responsible for translation and interpretation in Japanese, English, and Nepali, as well as the recruitment, training, and labor management of foreign staff. In the field, I provided operational guidance and support to ensure smooth workflow. Additionally, I served as a bridge between foreign staff and Japanese staff, facilitating effective communication and contributing to a more cohesive multicultural work environment.

Through my experience working at an airport duty-free shop, I handled a wide range of responsibilities, including product sales, inventory management, cashier operations, customer service interpretation, and various back-office tasks. These duties enabled me to develop fast, efficient, and attentive customer service skills. I also strengthened my ability to assist a diverse, multinational customer base, ensuring smooth and effective communication. Furthermore, my contributions supported improved customer satisfaction and enhanced overall service quality.

I have experience working with CMS platforms to build and maintain webpages, primarily setting up English-language pages and coordinating with organizers via Outlook. My role also involved assisting international customers through email support and preparing monthly English newsletters using Excel. Through these tasks, I developed strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage digital content efficiently.
